entries.zh-Hans: 冲锋
entries.en: Opener

entries.zh-Hans: 本回合第一张主动牌触发。
entries.en: Triggers on the first actively played card this round.

entries.zh-Hans: 收招
entries.en: Finisher

entries.zh-Hans: 结束回合时，最后一张主动牌触发。
entries.en: Triggers at turn end if this was the last actively played card.

entries.zh-Hans: 重箭
entries.en: Heavy Arrow

entries.zh-Hans: 消耗全部蓄力，按消耗量强化本牌。
entries.en: Spend all Charge to strengthen this card.

entries.zh-Hans: 编序
entries.en: Sequence

entries.zh-Hans: 按本次任务的记录顺序改变效果。
entries.en: Changes the effect according to the order recorded for this task.

entries.zh-Hans: 法术任务
entries.en: Spell Task

entries.zh-Hans: 本组不同法术各主动打出1次，依序免费重放；每回合限1次。
entries.en: Actively play each distinct spell in this set 1 time, then replay them for free in order; limited to 1 time per round.

entries.zh-Hans: 阵赏
entries.en: Formation Reward

entries.zh-Hans: 任务重放后，领取首牌奖励。
entries.en: After the task replay, gain the reward set by the first recorded card.

entries.zh-Hans: 通用
entries.en: Universal

entries.zh-Hans: 作首牌时，第2张记录牌决定分支；核心或通用牌对应普通分支。
entries.en: If played first, the 2nd recorded card determines the branch; a core or universal card selects the normal branch.

entries.zh-Hans: 自动入手
entries.en: Auto Draw

entries.zh-Hans: 从抽牌堆或弃牌堆自动加入手牌。
entries.en: Automatically add the card to your hand from the draw or discard pile.

entries.zh-Hans: 药方
entries.en: Prescription

entries.zh-Hans: 首次打出开启本场效果；药方互不触发。
entries.en: The first play activates its effect for this battle; prescriptions do not trigger each other.

entries.zh-Hans: 检索
entries.en: Search

entries.zh-Hans: 从抽牌堆或弃牌堆选牌入手。
entries.en: Choose a card from the draw or discard pile and add it to your hand.

entries.zh-Hans: 毒爆
entries.en: Poison Burst

entries.zh-Hans: 依次触发流血、中毒、灼烧和蚀伤各一次。
entries.en: Trigger Bleed, Poison, Burn and Corrosion in that order.

entries.zh-Hans: 冰爆
entries.en: Ice Burst

entries.zh-Hans: 消耗全部护甲攻击全体敌方；每点护甲增加1个攻击百分点。
entries.en: Spend all Armor to attack all enemies; each point of Armor adds 1 attack percentage point.

entries.zh-Hans: 治疗反转
entries.en: Healing Reversal

entries.zh-Hans: 对敌方使用时，将治疗转为等量生命损失。
entries.en: When used on an enemy, turn healing into equal HP loss.

entries.zh-Hans: 无视防御
entries.en: Ignore Defense

entries.zh-Hans: 本次攻击忽略指定数值的防御。
entries.en: This attack ignores the specified amount of Defense.

entries.zh-Hans: 消耗
entries.en: Exhaust

entries.zh-Hans: 打出后，本场不再抽到此牌。
entries.en: After being played, this card cannot be drawn again during this battle.

entries.zh-Hans: 临时复制
entries.en: Temporary Copy

entries.zh-Hans: 复制原牌；副本在生成它的回合结束时消失。
entries.en: Copy the original card; the copy disappears at the end of the round in which it was created.

entries.zh-Hans: 藏式
entries.en: Stored Stance

entries.zh-Hans: 保存冲锋效果，供下回合首张主动牌使用；该回合结束时失效。
entries.en: Store an Opener effect for the first actively played card next round; it expires at the end of that round.

entries.zh-Hans: 开锋
entries.en: Unsheathe

entries.zh-Hans: 本牌使用藏式时触发。
entries.en: Triggers when this card uses Stored Stance.

entries.zh-Hans: 余式
entries.en: Follow-up Stance

entries.zh-Hans: 供本回合下一张主动牌再使用1次藏式；不会继续复制。
entries.en: Let the next actively played card this round reuse Stored Stance 1 time; it does not copy itself again.

entries.zh-Hans: 血势
entries.en: Blood Momentum

entries.zh-Hans: 每点目标流血使指定攻击倍率增加2个百分点。
entries.en: Each Bleed on the target adds 2 percentage points to the specified attack multiplier.

entries.zh-Hans: 乘势
entries.en: Ride Momentum

entries.zh-Hans: 每层自身气势使指定攻击倍率增加10个百分点；未注明则不消耗。
entries.en: Each Momentum on self adds 10 percentage points to the specified attack multiplier; it is not spent unless stated.

entries.zh-Hans: 护甲
entries.en: Armor

entries.zh-Hans: 抵挡攻击与固定伤害；本方回合开始清空。
entries.en: Absorbs attacks and fixed damage; clears at the start of your side's turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 气势
entries.en: Momentum

entries.zh-Hans: 每层使每段直接攻击伤害+1；普通攻击不消耗，也不衰减。
entries.en: Each stack adds +1 damage to every direct attack hit; ordinary attacks do not spend it, and it does not decay.

entries.zh-Hans: 灵动
entries.en: Agility

entries.zh-Hans: 25%概率耗1层完美闪避；否则有2层便耗2层闪避。
entries.en: 25% chance to spend 1 stack for a perfect dodge; otherwise, if you have 2 stacks, spend 2 stacks to dodge.

entries.zh-Hans: 破绽
entries.en: Vulnerability

entries.zh-Hans: 每层使下一段直接攻击伤害+10%；有效命中后清空。
entries.en: Each stack adds +10% damage to the next direct attack hit; clears after a successful hit.

entries.zh-Hans: 标记
entries.en: Mark

entries.zh-Hans: 所受直接攻击+15%，有效命中耗1层；敌人通常优先攻击有标记的友方。
entries.en: Take +15% direct attack damage; a successful hit spends 1 stack. Enemies usually prioritize marked allies.

entries.zh-Hans: 虚弱
entries.en: Weak

entries.zh-Hans: 直接攻击伤害降低50%；本方回合结束减少1层。
entries.en: Direct attack damage is reduced by 50%; lose 1 stack at the end of your side's turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 流血
entries.en: Bleed

entries.zh-Hans: 被攻击命中后，额外失去等同流血值的生命。
entries.en: After an attack hits, lose additional HP equal to Bleed.

entries.zh-Hans: 中毒
entries.en: Poison

entries.zh-Hans: 任意一方回合结束时，失去等同中毒值的生命。
entries.en: At the end of either side's turn, lose HP equal to Poison.

entries.zh-Hans: 灼烧
entries.en: Burn

entries.zh-Hans: 自己的牌或意图结束后，失去等同灼烧值的生命。
entries.en: After your own card or intent finishes, lose HP equal to Burn.

entries.zh-Hans: 蚀伤
entries.en: Corrosion

entries.zh-Hans: 被毒爆或指定效果触发时，失去等同蚀伤值的生命。
entries.en: When triggered by Poison Burst or a specified effect, lose HP equal to Corrosion.

entries.zh-Hans: 药效
entries.en: Potency

entries.zh-Hans: 治疗前全部消耗，每点使基础治疗+1；累计每获得6点，得到1层气势。
entries.en: Spend all before healing; each point adds +1 base healing. Every 6 Potency gained cumulatively grants 1 Momentum.

entries.zh-Hans: 蓄力
entries.en: Charge

entries.zh-Hans: 用于强化重箭，发动重箭时全部消耗。
entries.en: Strengthens Heavy Arrow; all stacks are spent when Heavy Arrow is used.

entries.zh-Hans: 援护
entries.en: Guard

entries.zh-Hans: 替目标承受单体攻击，每次消耗1次。
entries.en: Take single-target attacks in place of the protected target; each use spends 1 charge.

entries.zh-Hans: 反击
entries.en: Counter

entries.zh-Hans: 对方单体直接攻击牌结算后反击，耗1次；不连锁触发。
entries.en: Counter after an opposing single-target direct attack card resolves; spend 1 charge. Counters do not chain.

entries.zh-Hans: 格挡
entries.en: Block

entries.zh-Hans: 对方单体直接攻击牌结算后，以攻击加剩余护甲反攻，耗1次；护甲保留。
entries.en: After an opposing single-target direct attack card resolves, retaliate with Attack plus remaining Armor; spend 1 charge and keep the Armor.

entries.zh-Hans: 破绽免疫
entries.en: Vulnerability Immunity

entries.zh-Hans: 免疫新施加的破绽。
entries.en: Immune to newly applied Vulnerability.

entries.zh-Hans: 追击标记
entries.en: Mark Follow-up

entries.zh-Hans: 下次攻击的首段命中施加1层标记，出手后耗1次。
entries.en: The first hit of the next attack applies 1 Mark; spend 1 charge after attacking.

entries.zh-Hans: 破绽追击
entries.en: Vulnerability Follow-up

entries.zh-Hans: 下次攻击的首段命中施加1层破绽，出手后耗1次。
entries.en: The first hit of the next attack applies 1 Vulnerability; spend 1 charge after attacking.

entries.zh-Hans: 疗愈增幅
entries.en: Healing Boost

entries.zh-Hans: 下次治疗的每个目标各增加当前数值的治疗量，随后清空。
entries.en: Add the current amount to healing for each target of the next heal, then clear it.

entries.zh-Hans: 地势双效
entries.en: Double Terrain

entries.zh-Hans: 下一次符合条件的地势收益额外结算1次，触发后耗1次。
entries.en: The next qualifying terrain benefit resolves 1 extra time; spend 1 charge after triggering.

entries.zh-Hans: 地势免耗
entries.en: Free Terrain

entries.zh-Hans: 下一张地势牌不消耗气力。
entries.en: The next terrain card costs no Qi.

entries.zh-Hans: 地势减耗
entries.en: Terrain Discount

entries.zh-Hans: 下一张地势牌少耗1点气力。
entries.en: The next terrain card costs 1 less Qi.

entries.zh-Hans: 代挡
entries.en: Redirect

entries.zh-Hans: 下一次敌方单体攻击转向指定友方，触发后耗1次。
entries.en: Redirect the next enemy single-target attack to the chosen ally; spend 1 charge after triggering.

entries.zh-Hans: 本回合地势双效
entries.en: Round Double Terrain

entries.zh-Hans: 本回合下一次符合条件的地势收益额外结算1次；触发或回合结束后失效。
entries.en: The next qualifying terrain benefit this round resolves 1 extra time; expires after triggering or at round end.

entries.zh-Hans: 财富
entries.en: Wealth

entries.zh-Hans: 上限8层，强化或供钱鼠招式消耗；具体收益看意图，转阶段保留。
entries.en: Up to 8 stacks. Strengthens or fuels the Coin Rat's moves; see its intent for details. Kept between phases.

entries.zh-Hans: 狂怒
entries.en: Rage

entries.zh-Hans: 上限5层，强化赤獠招式；每张玩家主动牌造成生命伤害后+1，转阶段保留。
entries.en: Up to 5 stacks. Empowers Redtusk's moves; +1 after each actively played player card that deals HP damage. Kept between phases.

entries.zh-Hans: 猎物
entries.en: Prey

entries.zh-Hans: 老虎锁定的目标；指定猎物的招式优先攻击它。
entries.en: The Tiger's chosen target; moves that specify Prey prioritize this unit.

entries.zh-Hans: 地势
entries.en: Terrain

entries.zh-Hans: 卡牌可触发场地收益；阵师伙伴存活时，玩家回合开始自动触发1次。
entries.en: Cards can trigger terrain benefits. While the Formation Master companion lives, trigger the benefit 1 time at the start of the player turn.

entries.zh-Hans: 蓄力／重箭
entries.en: Charge / Heavy Arrow

entries.zh-Hans: 本牌术语
entries.en: Card terms

entries.zh-Hans: 无额外关键词说明。
entries.en: No additional terms.

entries.zh-Hans: 持续伤害直接损失生命，触发不消耗数值。
entries.en: Damage over time removes HP directly. Triggering it does not spend its stacks.

entries.zh-Hans: Ctrl：返回牌面 · Shift：详述
entries.en: Ctrl: return to card · Shift: full details

entries.zh-Hans: 代挡：下一次敌方单体攻击转向指定友方，触发后耗1次。
entries.en: Redirect: Redirect the next enemy single-target attack to the chosen ally; spend 1 charge after triggering.

entries.zh-Hans: 本回合地势双效：本回合下一次符合条件的地势收益额外结算1次；触发或回合结束后失效。
entries.en: Round Double Terrain: The next qualifying terrain benefit this round resolves 1 extra time; expires after triggering or at round end.

entries.zh-Hans: 财富：上限8层，强化或供钱鼠招式消耗；具体收益看意图，转阶段保留。
entries.en: Wealth: Up to 8 stacks. Strengthens or fuels the Coin Rat's moves; see its intent for details. Kept between phases.

entries.zh-Hans: 狂怒：上限5层，强化赤獠招式；每张玩家主动牌造成生命伤害后+1，转阶段保留。
entries.en: Rage: Up to 5 stacks. Empowers Redtusk's moves; +1 after each actively played player card that deals HP damage. Kept between phases.

entries.zh-Hans: 猎物：老虎锁定的目标；指定猎物的招式优先攻击它。
entries.en: Prey: The Tiger's chosen target; moves that specify Prey prioritize this unit.

entries.zh-Hans: 地势：卡牌可触发场地收益；阵师伙伴存活时，玩家回合开始自动触发1次。
entries.en: Terrain: Cards can trigger terrain benefits. While the Formation Master companion lives, trigger the benefit 1 time at the start of the player turn.

entries.nativePattern: 法术任务：本组%d种牌各主动打出1次，依序免费重放；每回合限1次。
entries.zh-Hans: 法术任务：本组{0}种牌各主动打出1次，依序免费重放；每回合限1次。
entries.en: Spell Task: Actively play each of the {0} card types in this set 1 time, then replay them for free in order; limited to 1 time per round.

entries.nativePattern: 反击：对方单体直接攻击牌结算后反击，%d%%攻击伤害；耗1次，不连锁。
entries.zh-Hans: 反击：对方单体直接攻击牌结算后反击，{0}%攻击伤害；耗1次，不连锁。
entries.en: Counter: Counter after an opposing single-target direct attack card resolves, dealing {0}% ATK damage; spend 1 charge. Counters do not chain.

entries.nativePattern: 格挡：对方单体直接攻击牌结算后，以%d%%攻击＋剩余护甲反击；耗1次，护甲保留。
entries.zh-Hans: 格挡：对方单体直接攻击牌结算后，以{0}%攻击＋剩余护甲反击；耗1次，护甲保留。
entries.en: Block: After an opposing single-target direct attack card resolves, counter with {0}% ATK plus remaining Armor; spend 1 charge and keep the Armor.

entries.zh-Hans: 蓄力／重箭：消耗全部蓄力，按消耗量强化本牌。
entries.en: Charge / Heavy Arrow: Spend all Charge to strengthen this card.
